---
title: "avax.issueTx"
---

Send a signed transaction to the network. `encoding` specifies the format of the signed transaction. Can only be `hex` when a value is provided.

This method will use `10` [Compute Units](/v1/about/billing).

***

## Reference: [Here](https://docs.avax.network/reference/avalanchego/c-chain/api#avaxissuetx)

## **Parameters**

* `tx` - string - The transaction encoded to encoding.
* `encoding` - string - The encoding format.

## Returns

* `txID` - string - The transaction ID in hex format.

```json
// Result 
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "txID": "NUPLwbt2hsYxpQg4H2o451hmTWQ4JZx2zMzM4SinwtHgAdX1JLPHXvWSXEnpecStLj"
  }
}
```

<CodeGroup>

```bash title="mainnet"
curl https://mainnet.avalanche.validationcloud.io/v1/<YOUR_API_KEY_HERE>/ext/bc/C/avax \
    -X POST \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{
    "jsonrpc":"2.0",
    "id"     :1,
    "method" :"avax.issueTx",
    "params" :{
        "tx":"",
        "encoding": "hex"

    }
}'
```

